content: Tested candidates 1 and 2. Candidate 2 (id=2, reward=-0.958) achieved current=180uA, PM=52.6 deg, gain=128, SR=22.3 V/us, UGBW=28.2 MHz, area=3.84e-10. Plan: Itail controls SR/input gm; I2 controls p2/PM and output drive; Cc trades PM against UGBW/SR; ln1/lp1/lp3/ln5 control gain. Moving to diagnoser.

Best id=2 infeasible. Violated specs ordered: ugbw (-0.561), gain (-0.220), slewRate (-0.148), phm (-0.066). Binding spec is ugbw. Lever: decrease cap (Cc) from 0.8pF to 0.4-0.5pF to boost UGBW and SR, with res (Rc) fine-tuned for PM.
Candidate 3 (base 2, cap 0.4pF, res 1600): UGBW 28.2->40.25MHz, SR 22.2->29.16V/us, PM 52.6->47.75 deg, reward -0.734. Prediction confirmed direction; UGBW and gain remain violated.

Candidate 3 binding specs: ugbw (-0.426), gain (-0.220), phm (-0.114), SR (-0.014). Lever: increase device lengths (lp1, lp3, ln5) to boost stage gains to >= 200, and shift Itail higher to boost gm1 for UGBW.

Candidate 5 confirmed that slew rate is bound by I2/(Cc+CL), dropping from 29.2 to 24.4 V/us when I2 dropped from 120uA to 90uA. High I2 (mn5 >= 4) with mp3 wide (mp3 >= 16) is required for SR >= 30 V/us and higher stage 2 gain.
Candidate 3 is closest to feasibility (reward -0.734). Sweeping cap over [1e-13 .. 6e-13] on base 3 to find optimal balance between UGBW/SR and PM in a single decision.
Sweep of cap confirmed candidate 6 (cap=1e-13 F) is best: reward -0.513, SR=39.71 (pass), UGBW=68.96 MHz, area=1.79e-10 m^2. Violated: gain (~128), phm (44.1 deg), ugbw (69 MHz).
Best id=6 (reward -0.513). Violated: gain, phm (44 deg), ugbw (69 MHz). Lever: sweep res on base 6 over [1500..6500] ohm to generate phase lead from the LHP zero and reach phm >= 60 deg.
Sweep of res on base 6 showed monotonic PM improvement up to 49.86 deg at res=6500 (id 16, reward -0.4717), with UGBW=67.9MHz, SR=39.8V/us. Gain (~128) and UGBW are next binding constraints.
Best id=16 (reward -0.472). Lever: increase lp1, lp3 to 135nm for gain >= 200, widen input pair mn1 to 16 for gm1/UGBW, and increase res to 8500 ohm for PM >= 60 deg.
Candidate 20 achieved gain=253.9 (passing >= 200), SR=32.3 V/us (passing), noise=0.0115 V (passing). Only ugbw (57.8 MHz) and phm (48.9 deg) remain violated. Best reward is Candidate 19 (-0.296).

Candidate 19 (reward -0.296): ugbw (68 MHz) and phm (52.8 deg) limited by Itail=30uA and large Cgs(mp3=16). Lever: mn4=2 (Itail=60uA), mp3=8 (halves Cgs, loads stage 1 less, keeps balance=4); expect UGBW > 85MHz and PM > 55 deg.

Handing over to rl: Phase 1 completed 24 simulations. Best candidate 21 (reward -0.2935) satisfies 5 specs (PM=65.2 deg, SR=31.0 V/us, noise=7.2mV, area, current). Only gain (151 vs 200) and UGBW (70 vs 100 MHz) violated. Handing over to rl-strategist for local exploration around candidate 21.

RL refinement complete: 780 sims used (100 warmup, 680 training). Best before: Candidate 21 (FoM -0.2935, infeasible). Best after: Candidate 338 (FoM +0.6594, feasible, 0 violations). Feasible designs: 4. Key parameter adaptations: ln1 increased to 90nm, Cc increased to 0.8pF, res adjusted to 7100, mp1=11/wp1=1u, mp3=16/wp3=1.75u, mn3=2/mn4=7/mn5=7. Ready for Phase 4 polish.

Candidate 338 is feasible (FoM=0.6594). Margins: PM +8.8 deg, SR +22 V/us, Gain +414. Lever: sweep cap over [5e-13 .. 9e-13] on base 338 to trade excess PM margin for smaller area and higher UGBW/SR, maximizing FoM = 0.3 - z_area - z_current.

Sweep of cap on base 338 found Candidate 805 (cap=5e-13 F): FoM increased to +0.7115 (feasible, 0 violations). Area reduced to 7.216e-10 m^2, PM=61.51 deg, UGBW=108.7 MHz, SR=64.02 V/us, current=224.7 uA.

Round 2 RL complete. Total sim calls: 968. Feasible designs found: 28. Best candidate is 836 (FoM = +0.7163, feasible, 0 violations). Specs: Gain=622.5, UGBW=107.3MHz, PM=60.59 deg, SR=64.28V/us, Noise=14.4mV, Area=7.11e-10 m^2, Current=225.1uA. Moving to Reviewer.

Final verified solution is Candidate 836 with FoM = +0.7163 (feasible, zero violations). Specs: Gain=622.5 V/V, UGBW=107.3 MHz, PM=60.59 deg, SR=64.28 V/us, Noise=14.4 mV RMS, Area=7.11e-10 m^2, Current=225.1 uA. Full report written to harness_runs/harness_20261106_190920/explanation.md.
